title: StreamingWAM: Streaming World Action Modeling via Chunk-Wise Staircase Flow Matching
title_zh: StreamingWAM：基于分块阶梯流匹配的流式世界动作建模

paragraphs.en: World Action Models (WAMs), often built upon pretrained video-generation world models, have emerged as a promising framework for general-purpose and open-ended robot control. However, their real-world deployment often suffers from discontinuous and jerky execution. Existing methods typically address this issue by either improving inference efficiency or enhancing action continuity across prediction chunks, without jointly addressing both challenges. To bridge this gap, we propose StreamingWAM, a streaming-diffusion framework for WAM-based robot control. StreamingWAM combines a noise ladder for chunk-wise action prediction, a prefix rollout module for cross-chunk continuity, and dense video-history memory for temporally consistent conditioning. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world robotic tasks demonstrate that StreamingWAM improves action continuity across static and dynamic settings, achieving competitive performance while reducing steady-state replanning latency to 72.9 ms in simulation and 57.3 ms on the real robot. The method also produces smoother action transitions, while the streaming staircase reduces sensitivity to the execution horizon K K .
paragraphs.zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通常构建在预训练的视频生成世界模型之上，已成为通用且开放式的机器人控制领域一种有前景的框架。 然而，它们在现实世界中的部署常常面临执行不连续和突兀的问题。 现有方法通常通过提升推理效率或增强预测片段之间的动作连续性来解决这一问题，但并未同时应对这两个挑战。 为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了 StreamingWAM——一种基于 WAM 的机器人控制的流式扩散框架。 StreamingWAM 结合了用于逐片段预测动作的噪声阶梯、用于跨片段保持连续性的前缀展开模块，以及用于实现时间一致条件约束的密集视频历史记忆。 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 2.0 及真实世界机器人任务上的实验表明，StreamingWAM 提升了静态和动态场景下的动作连续性，在保持竞争力的同时，将稳态重新规划延迟降低至模拟环境中的 72.9 毫秒和真实机器人上的 57.3 毫秒。 该方法还能产生更平滑的动作过渡，而流式阶梯结构则降低了对执行时域 K K 的敏感性。

paragraphs.en: Recent WAMs are built upon world models, particularly pretrained video-generation models ( Ye et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026b ; Yuan et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ) . Through pretraining objectives based on future-state prediction, these models acquire knowledge of environment dynamics, which is then adapted to robotic domains via fine-tuning for general-purpose and open-ended robot control ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . By leveraging this learned dynamics prior, WAMs can exhibit strong generalization when deployed on real-world robots across diverse tasks and environments ( Wang et al., 2026b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 近期的世界模型智能体（WAM）构建于世界模型之上，尤其是预训练的视频生成模型（Ye et al., 2026b；Li et al., 2026b；Yuan et al., 2026；Kim et al., 2026）。 通过基于未来状态预测的预训练目标，这些模型获得了环境动态的知识，随后通过针对通用和开放式机器人控制的微调，将其适配到机器人领域（Zhang et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2026a）。 通过利用这种学习到的动态先验知识，世界模型智能体在部署于真实世界的机器人上执行多样化任务和任务时，能够展现出强大的泛化能力（Wang et al., 2026b）。

paragraphs.en: Despite their impressive performance, WAMs often exhibit temporally discontinuous and jerky motions during closed-loop execution ( MotuBrain Team, 2026 ; Black et al., 2025 ) . This behavior is closely tied to their non-streaming inference procedure: at each replan, existing WAMs regenerate a complete action chunk from scratch through multi-step denoising and discard the unexecuted suffix of the previous plan. This procedure creates two coupled limitations. First, the combination of a large video-generation backbone, joint video–action processing, and iterative denoising makes WAM inference computationally expensive. Regenerating a complete action chunk at every replan further compounds this cost, resulting in substantial response latency and slower adaptation to new observations ( Lu et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026 ; Cai et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ) . Second, independently generated chunks may be inconsistent with previously executed actions, causing abrupt transitions at replanning boundaries ( Lu et al., 2026 ; Høeg et al., 2024 ) . Existing methods typically improve either inference efficiency or cross-chunk action continuity, but rarely both within a unified framework.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 WAM 的表现令人印象深刻，但在闭环执行过程中，它们常常表现出时间上不连续且突兀的动作（MotuBrain Team, 2026；Black 等, 2025）。 这种行为与其非流式推理过程密切相关：在每次重新规划时，现有的 WAM 会通过多步降噪从头生成一个完整的动作片段，并丢弃先前计划中尚未执行的部分。 这一过程造成了两个相互关联的局限性。 首先，大型视频生成主干模型、联合的视频-动作处理以及迭代降噪的结合，使得 WAM 的推理计算成本高昂。 每次重新规划都需重新生成完整的动作片段，进一步加剧了这一成本问题，导致显著的响应延迟以及对新观察信息的适应速度变慢（Lu 等, 2026；Ma 等, 2026；Cai 等, 2026；Li 等, 2026a）。 其次，独立生成的动作片段可能与先前执行的动作不一致，从而在重新规划的边界处造成突兀的转换（Lu 等, 2026；Høeg 等, 2024）。 现有方法通常只能提升推理效率或动作片段间的连贯性，但很少能在统一框架内同时实现这两者。

paragraphs.en: To bridge this gap, we propose StreamingWAM ( Figure 1 ), which introduces a streaming diffusion paradigm into WAMs. Specifically, the noise ladder staggers future action blocks across noise levels in a persistent buffer, enabling low-latency, single-step steady-state replanning. The prefix rollout module conditions future-action denoising on a clean prefix of recently executed actions, improving continuity across action chunks. Finally, dense video-history memory provides recent visual context for action prediction, supporting temporally consistent responses to state changes.
paragraphs.zh: 为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了 StreamingWAM（图 1），它将流式扩散范式引入 WAM。 具体而言，噪声阶梯将未来的动作块在持续缓冲区中跨不同噪声层级错开分布，从而实现低延迟的单步稳态重新规划。 前缀展开模块将未来动作的降噪过程与最近执行动作的干净前缀相关联，从而提升各动作片段之间的连贯性。 最后，密集的视频历史记忆为动作预测提供近期的视觉上下文，支持对状态变化做出时间上一致的反应。

paragraphs.en: Two dominant paradigms have emerged for generalist robot control. Vision-language-action models (VLAs) such as π 0 \pi_{0} ( Black et al., 2024 ) and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} ( Physical Intelligence et al., 2025 ) build on pretrained vision-language models, combining Internet-scale semantic knowledge with large-scale cross-embodiment robot training. WAMs instead build on pretrained video-generation models and jointly predict future visual states and actions, transferring video-derived dynamics priors to robot control. DreamZero ( Ye et al., 2026b ) and LingBot-VA ( Li et al., 2026b ) demonstrated the viability of this paradigm, achieving strong generalization across environments and embodiments. However, large video backbones and iterative joint video–action denoising introduce substantial inference latency, limiting high-frequency closed-loop control.

paragraphs.en: We propose StreamingWAM ( Figure 2 ), a streaming diffusion formulation built on a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) WAM with dedicated video and action experts. It combines a prefix rollout module that conditions prediction on clean executed actions, a noise ladder that progressively refines a persistent future-action buffer, and dense video-history memory that supplies recent visual context. Together, these components amortize denoising across planning calls, reducing steady-state latency while improving cross-chunk continuity. StreamingWAM requires neither additional trainable parameters nor additional training data.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 StreamingWAM（图 2），这是一种基于混合 Transformer（MoT）WAM 的流式扩散框架，并配备了专用的视频和动作专家模型。 它结合了一个前缀展开模块（通过已正确执行的动作来约束预测）、一个噪声阶梯模块（逐步优化持续存在的未来动作缓冲区）以及一个密集视频历史记忆模块（提供近期的视觉上下文）。 这些组件协同工作，可在多次规划调用中摊销去噪成本，从而在降低稳态延迟的同时提升跨片段连贯性。 StreamingWAM 既不需要额外的可训练参数，也不需要额外的训练数据。

paragraphs.zh: 在此，o t − m + 1 : t o_{t-m+1:t} 构成了密集的视频历史记忆，捕捉短期视觉动态，以补充已执行动作的前缀，从而提升动作生成的时间一致性。随着规划推进，新执行的动作会被整合到条件前缀中，而 ℬ t \mathcal{B}_{t} 中尚未执行的部分则被向前移动并重复使用。因此，重叠的未来动作无需从头再生，从而打破了第 3.1 节所述的标准 WAM 推理中的跨调用独立性。遵循 Black 等人（2025）的研究，动作前缀所提供的长期上下文也优于短期的视觉历史窗口。

paragraphs.en: We conduct experiments on LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023 ) and LIBERO-Plus ( Fei et al., 2025 ) . paragraphs.en: Following Fast-WAM ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) , we build our WAM on Wan2.2-TI2V-5B. The action-expert backbone is initialized by linearly interpolating the pretrained video-DiT weights to its dimensions and applying α \alpha -scaling to preserve their magnitude, while the action-specific encoder and output head are randomly initialized. At inference, ℬ 0 \mathcal{B}_{0} is initialized using a 10-step flow-matching sampler and re-noised according to the staircase. Each subsequent planning call uses a single Euler update. Detailed training and inference configurations, including the number of optimization and denoising steps, action and execution horizons, are provided in Appendix A . For controlled training-budget comparisons, Fast-WAM-Joint and StreamingWAM start from the same benchmark-specific Joint checkpoint and receive the same number of additional optimisation steps under the Joint and streaming objectives, respectively. The main-table LIBERO-Plus baseline instead follows the official FastWAM-Joint evaluation configuration, as stated in the table caption.

paragraphs.en: Two complementary temporal effects may explain the task-level gains. First, the largest margins occur on the dynamic tasks. A single frame locates an object but generally leaves its velocity ambiguous, whereas consecutive real observations reveal frame-to-frame motion. This temporal evidence may allow the WAM’s future-state predictor to anticipate object motion before action selection. At the same time, single-step streaming replanning lowers the steady-state latency, allowing those predictions to be refreshed at the task’s reaction time scale. The dynamic gains therefore plausibly reflect the joint effect of motion evidence from real observation history, the WAM’s predictive prior, and low-latency replanning, rather than any one factor alone. In stage-matched conveyor trials, FastWAM-Joint largely freezes the apple, whereas StreamingWAM predicts displacement along the conveyor direction. The corresponding qualitative future-video prediction sequence and displacement measurements are provided in the appendix ( Figure 9 ). Because the examples come from independent trials and the models differ in more than their visual context, they provide qualitative mechanism evidence rather than a controlled history-only ablation. Second, temporal context may also help track progress in multi-stage tasks. On weigh-and-place, StreamingWAM succeeds in 42/50 trials versus 25/50 for the strongest baseline. Recent observations together with the executed-action history provide short-horizon context about whether the weighing stage has been completed and whether the apple should next be transferred to the bowl. This interpretation is consistent with the task-level gain, although it remains to be isolated by a task-specific context ablation.
paragraphs.zh: 两种互补的时间效应或许可以解释任务层面的性能提升。 首先，动态任务中出现了最大的性能差距。 单帧图像只能定位物体，但通常无法确定其速度；而连续的真实观测则能揭示帧与帧之间的运动。 这种时间证据可能使 WAM 的未来状态预测器在动作选择前就能预判物体的运动。 同时，单步流式重新规划降低了稳态延迟，使得这些预测能够在任务的反应时间尺度上得到更新。 因此，动态任务中的性能提升很可能反映了真实观测历史提供的运动证据、WAM 的预测先验以及低延迟重新规划的共同作用，而非单一因素所致。 在阶段匹配的传送带实验中，FastWAM-Joint 基本使苹果保持静止，而 StreamingWAM 则预测了苹果沿传送带方向的位移。 相应的定性未来视频预测序列和位移测量结果已附在附录中（图 9）。 由于这些示例来自独立的实验，且模型之间的差异不仅限于视觉上下文，因此它们提供的是一种定性的机制证据，而非仅针对历史信息的受控消融分析。 其次，时间上下文可能也有助于在多阶段任务中追踪进展。 在“称重与放置”任务中，StreamingWAM 在 50 次实验中成功完成了 42 次，而最强的基线模型仅成功完成 25 次。 近期的观测结果结合已执行动作的历史记录，提供了短期上下文信息，用以判断称重阶段是否已完成，以及苹果接下来是否应被转移到碗中。 这种解释与任务层面的性能提升一致，但仍有待通过针对特定任务的上下文消融分析加以验证。

paragraphs.en: Our study has two main limitations. First, our experiments use a single base-model family, Fast-WAM . Although the streaming formulation does not require a specific WAM backbone, its effectiveness on other backbones remains to be validated. Second, our model does not use large-scale embodied pre-training. On RoboTwin 2.0’s randomized-initialization split, embodied-pretrained policies such as π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} ( Physical Intelligence et al., 2025 ) retain substantially higher success under scene variation. This gap may partly reflect the broader data coverage and stronger generalization provided by cross-embodiment pre-training. Combining such pre-training with streaming denoising is an important direction for future work.

paragraphs.en: We presented StreamingWAM, a streaming-diffusion framework that amortizes action denoising across planning calls through a persistent rolling buffer. Its streaming staircase progressively refines future actions, while the executed-action prefix and dense visual history maintain temporal context across replans. Across LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-robot tasks, StreamingWAM achieves competitive task success, reduces steady-state replanning latency to 72.9 ms in simulation and 57.3 ms on the real robot, improves cross-chunk action continuity, and compresses execution-horizon sensitivity from 35.75 to 6.50 percentage points. Its largest real-robot gains appear on moving-target and multi-stage tasks, consistent with the value of temporal context and responsive replanning. Together, these results support streaming action generation as a practical approach to more responsive and continuous WAM control.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 StreamingWAM，这是一种流式扩散框架，通过一个持续滚动的缓冲区，在多次规划调用中分摊动作去噪的开销。 其流式阶梯结构能逐步优化未来动作，而已执行动作的前缀和密集视觉历史则能在多次重新规划中保持时间上下文。 在 LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 2.0 和真实机器人任务中，StreamingWAM 实现了具有竞争力的任务成功率，将稳态重新规划延迟降低至模拟环境中的 72.9 毫秒和真实机器人上的 57.3 毫秒，提升了跨片段动作的连续性，并将执行时长的敏感度从 35.75 个百分点压缩至 6.50 个百分点。 其在真实机器人上的最大提升体现在移动目标和多阶段任务中，这与时间上下文和响应式重新规划的价值一致。 综合来看，这些结果支持将流式动作生成视为实现更响应迅速、更连续 WAM 控制的一种实用方法。

paragraphs.en: The LIBERO comparison includes 13 baselines spanning both VLA policies and WAMs, grouped according to whether they use embodied data during pretraining. The RoboTwin comparison additionally includes AHA-WAM ( Cai et al., 2026 ) . Among these, Fast-WAM-Joint , the jointly trained variant of Fast-WAM , serves as our closest direct baseline because it shares the same model architecture with StreamingWAM while omitting the three modules introduced in Section 3.2 .

paragraphs.en: We evaluate six manipulation tasks, grouped by whether the target object moves during execution. Static tasks : block stacking —stack five layers of blocks; open drawer —grasp the handle and pull the drawer open; and weigh-and-place —place an apple on a kitchen scale, read the weight, then transfer it to a bowl. Dynamic tasks : conveyor handover —pick a moving apple off a conveyor belt and place it into a bowl; car pursuit —intercept an apple riding a curved-path toy car and place it into a bowl; and whack-a-mole —press the randomly lit button on a response-time toy. The dynamic tasks require the policy to continuously adapt its actions to moving objects and therefore directly evaluate reactive control in time-varying environments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了六个操控任务，并根据执行过程中目标物体是否移动对这些任务进行了分组。 静态任务：堆叠积木——堆叠五层积木；打开抽屉——抓住把手并将抽屉拉开；以及称重放置——将苹果放在厨房秤上读取重量，然后将其转移到碗中。 动态任务：传送带交接——从移动的传送带上拿起一个苹果并放入碗中；汽车追逐——拦截一辆沿曲线路径行驶的玩具车上的苹果并将其放入碗中；以及打地鼠——按下反应时间玩具上随机亮起的按钮。 动态任务要求策略能够持续调整其动作以适应移动物体，因此可以直接评估在时变环境中的反应控制能力。
